title: Your notes, within reach
narration: Welcome to Holdfast, a home for your notes on your Mac. In this short tour, we'll find a decision, check its source, and make a change that you approve. Everything shown here uses fictional sample notes.

title: Choose where answers run
narration: Start by choosing your notes folder and an answer model. In Settings, Local M L X is the default: it runs the model inside Holdfast on your Mac. Download a model that fits your available memory. You can also connect Ollama, L M Studio, or a compatible server. A server receives the context needed for your request.

title: A familiar place to browse
narration: The Library lets you browse your notes and read them in the app. Here is our kitchen repair plan, with a budget and a few decisions. Your notes remain ordinary files. You can keep using your favorite editor alongside Holdfast.

title: Ask a question in plain words
tip: “What did I decide about the kitchen repair?”
narration: Open Ask and type a question your notes can answer. Let's ask: What did I decide about the kitchen repair? Holdfast searches the notes and answers with sources. This answer was generated by a local model. We've removed the waiting time from this tour; the time you'll need depends on your Mac and model.

title: Check the source
narration: Open a numbered citation to read the source passage beside the answer. Here, we can check the repair choices and the eighteen hundred dollar budget against the original note. Treat the answer as a helpful starting point, and use the source to check the details.

title: You have the final say
narration: Now let's update the checklist. Ask: Mark Book the inspection as done in my home checklist. Holdfast prepares a proposal in the Inbox. The file hasn't changed yet. Review the removed text in red and the replacement in green. You can edit the proposal before applying it.

title: Apply only when you're ready
narration: Choose Apply Change to save it. Holdfast first saves a copy, then updates the note. Only the inspection checkbox changes. If someone has edited the note since the proposal was made, Holdfast refuses to overwrite it, so you can review a fresh proposal instead.

title: Room to change your mind
narration: Changed your mind? Open Recently filed in the Inbox and choose Undo. Holdfast restores the saved copy. We checked that this sample checklist returned exactly to its original contents. Review, apply, and undo all stay under your control.

title: Try it with the sample notes
tip: Download the sample vault below the video
narration: You're ready to try it. Download the sample notes from the tour page, choose that folder in Holdfast, and ask the same kitchen question. Then try the checklist edit. The getting started guide walks you through installation, models, and your first question.
